title: 1828 Prairie's bay rises into the roof as its photograph shows
items: The Shipman house's canted front bay now carries on up past the cornice under its own slate mansard, with iron cresting round its top and a dormer of its own, as the Glessner House Museum's photograph of the house shows it.
The roof's dormer that stood over the bay is gone, since the photograph shows none beside the bay's crown.
